document.cue: Describe something you do to help the environment.

text: One thing I've been doing for the past couple of years is separating my household waste and taking recyclables to a collection point. It started as a small experiment, but it's gradually turned into a habit that I can't imagine giving up.

In practice, it means keeping three bags in the kitchen: one for paper, one for plastic and glass, and one for general rubbish. Every other Saturday, I take the first two to a container about ten minutes from my building, which is honestly the most inconvenient part, since our city doesn't offer kerbside collection. I originally began after watching a documentary about plastic accumulating in the oceans, which really shook me. Since then, I've also cut down on single-use items: I carry a reusable bottle and a cloth bag, and I buy second-hand clothes whenever possible. My flatmates were sceptical at first, but they've since joined in.

Do I think it makes a real difference? Realistically, my individual contribution is tiny compared with what industries emit. Nevertheless, I believe personal habits matter in two ways. Firstly, they influence people around us, and I've noticed my family now recycles too. Secondly, they create demand for better infrastructure, because when enough citizens ask for it, authorities eventually respond. So while I'm not under any illusion that I'm saving the planet, I'd feel hypocritical if I did nothing.

tips.en: The form stresses a period that began in the past and continues now.
tips.kk: Форма өткенде басталып, қазір жалғасып жатқан кезеңді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Форма подчёркивает период, начавшийся в прошлом и идущий сейчас.
tips.example: One thing I've been doing for the past couple of years is separating my household waste

tips.en: A question at the start of the conclusion highlights the answer structure.
tips.kk: Қорытынды басындағы сұрақ жауаптың құрылымын көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Вопрос в начале финала подчёркивает структуру ответа.
tips.example: Do I think it makes a real difference?

tips.en: Nevertheless introduces the argument after admitting limits.
tips.kk: Nevertheless шектеулерді мойындағаннан кейін дәлел келтіреді.
tips.ru: Nevertheless вводит аргумент после признания ограничений.
tips.example: Nevertheless, I believe personal habits matter in two ways

note.en: Things thrown away after one use.
A formal phrase for unrealistic belief.
Names the habit, the timescale and how an experiment became routine.
note.kk: Әдетті, мерзімін және тәжірибенің әдетке айналғанын атайды.
note.ru: Называет привычку, срок и постепенное превращение эксперимента в привычку.

note.en: Shows the practice, the trigger and how the habit expanded.
note.kk: Тәжірибені, бастау себебін және әдеттің басқа әрекеттерге кеңеюін көрсетеді.
note.ru: Показывает практику, причину начала и расширение привычки на другие действия.

note.en: Answers the final bullet critically: admits limits and gives two arguments.
note.kk: Соңғы тармаққа сыни жауап береді: шектеулерді мойындап, екі дәлел келтіреді.
note.ru: Отвечает на последний пункт карточки критически: признаёт ограничения и приводит два довода.
